# FocusCanvas v0.2.1

This patch release fixes Google Drive authentication in official Windows builds.

## Fixed

- Official release builds now read both Google OAuth values from repository secrets.
- Windows release builds fail immediately when either OAuth credential is missing instead of producing a broken installer.
- Google Drive sync and restore remain compatible with backups created by previous local builds that use the same Google OAuth Desktop client and Google account.

## Included

- Task-backed canvas groups.
- Google Drive backup inspection and new-device restore flow.
- Updated Tasks and Canvases screenshots in the README.
- Public FocusCanvas design documentation page.
